newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan buys 10,000 tonnes of rice in tender.
newsitem.headline: Japan buys 10,000 tonnes of rice in tender.

text.p: The Food Agency of Japan said on Friday that it bought 10,000 tonnes of rice in an import tender.
It said it bought 7,159 tonnes from the United States, 2,199 from China, 319 from Uruguay, 272 from Australia, and 51 from Thailand.

Under the 1993 Uruguay Round world trade agreement, Japan agreed to gradually open its rice market and committed itself to importing 511,000 tonnes of rice during this fiscal year, which ends in March 1997.
It has bought 155,300 tonnes so far this fiscal year, mainly from Thailand, Australia and the United States.
